description: List all employees in the company directory with a compact field set.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with an 'employees' list.

description: Get a single employee by id.

employee_id.description: The unique id of the employee.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the employee object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

hireDate.description: Optional hire date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; defaults to today.

supervisorId.description: Optional id of the supervising employee.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created employee; on failure (missing name), output contains an error message.

description: List time-off requests, optionally filtered by status and employee.

status.description: Optional status filter (requested, approved, denied, canceled).

employeeId.description: Optional employee id to filter requests by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of time-off request objects.

description: Create a new time-off request for an employee.

employeeId.description: The id of the employee requesting time off (required).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created request; on failure (employee not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the status of an existing time-off request.

request_id.description: The id of the time-off request to update.

status.description: New status; one of requested, approved, denied, canceled.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated request; on failure (not found or invalid status), output contains an error message.

description: List who is out of office, optionally within a date range.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of who's-out entries.

description: Get a synthesized report by id (report 1 = headcount by department).

report_id.description: The report id; only '1' (headcount by department) is available.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the report object; on failure (report not found), output contains an error message.
